story.title: The Round Ball
story.text: {{name}} set off across space with a little ball that had lost its shape. On every planet something was wrong: colors washed out, sizes all mixed up. The planets can only be fixed with code — real code, written by hand. Write a property, and the planet answers at once.

level.wrongProperty: You got the look you wanted — well done! But the property to use here is {{property}}.
level.hint2: The answer shape is hidden. Click to reveal.

colors/01-what-color.text: {{name}} bought a ball on the Colors planet, but the seller mixed it up and gave a grey one. Make the name under the ball green.
colors/01-what-color.intro: The color property paints text. Put it in the editor and choose a green value.
